answer_1.quote: We develop models to automatically perform the proposed three tasks on DECOR. ... These models achieve results comparable to GPT-4 in detecting incoherence and producing rewrites that match the quality of those generated by human experts.

answer_2.quote: We measured the systems' performance on the task of incoherence rewriting with the acceptance rate. ... Additionally, in line with the recent practices of evaluating instruction-following LLMs, we asked GPT-4 to rank a pair of generated rewrites ... to decide which one is more coherent to the context C. For each tested model, we collect its win rate against the human reference.

answer_3.quote: we specifically employed GPT-4 with 16-shot examples ... to determine if the rewrites S' are acceptable. Additionally, ... we asked GPT-4 to rank a pair of generated rewrites ... to decide which one is more coherent to the context C.

answer_4.quote: Moreover, we conducted a human evaluation where we asked our human expert to judge and compare system-generated rewrites with those produced by GPT-4.
